args.command:
cd /tau/self; node - <<'EOF'
import { args, files, run } from '@api/tau'

const { word } = args() as { word: string }
console.log(JSON.stringify(await run('/tau/self/taus/shout', { files: { out: files().report }, args: { text: word } })))
EOF
args.description: Run the shout TAU on the word
